attempted_correction.remedy_detail: If live or blank-firing firearms are utilized on set, conduct a safety meeting with all involved personnel to review relevant safety issues, including an on-site walk-through or dry run, and ensure appropriate PPE such as hearing and eye protection is issued and used by personnel in close proximity or in the line of fire. Alternatively, eliminate on-set live blank discharges entirely by using non-firing replica rifles or rubber props, adding muzzle flashes, smoke, and audio volley sound effects during post-production. Confirm the planned shooting method, staging, and prop choices with the production team.
